<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="fr" dir="ltr"><head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Club de Lutte â€” Excellence &amp; Tradition</title>
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700;900&amp;display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
    
    :root {
      --bg-primary: #0a0a0a;
      --bg-secondary: #171717;
      --bg-card: #1a1a1a;
      --bg-hover: #262626;
      --red-500: #ef4444;
      --red-600: #dc2626;
      --red-700: #b91c1c;
      --text-primary: #ffffff;
      --text-secondary: #d4d4d4;
      --text-muted: #a3a3a3;
      --text-dim: #737373;
      --border: #404040;
      --border-light: #ffffff1a;
    }

    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
    
    body {
      font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
      background: var(--bg-primary);
      color: var(--text-primary);
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
      -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
      line-height: 1.6;
      overflow-x: hidden;
    }

    ::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 8px; }
    ::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: var(--bg-primary); }
    ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: #262626; border-radius: 4px; }
    ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover { background: var(--red-600); }

    /* ===== NAVBAR ===== */
    .navbar {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
      z-index: 1000;
      padding: 1rem 1.5rem;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      background: rgba(10,10,10,0.85);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light);
      transition: all 0.3s;
    }
    .navbar.scrolled { background: rgba(10,10,10,0.95); }
    .nav-logo {
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem;
      text-decoration: none; color: var(--text-primary);
    }
    .nav-logo-icon {
      width: 48px; height: 48px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--red-500), var(--red-700));
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      font-weight: 900; font-size: 1.2rem;
      overflow: hidden; flex-shrink: 0;
      border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.18);
      box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(220,38,38,0.45);
    }
    .nav-logo-icon svg, .nav-logo-icon img {
      width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 50%; display: block;
    }
    .nav-logo-text { font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.1rem; letter-spacing: 0.02em; }
    .nav-links {
      display: none; gap: 2rem; list-style: none;
    }
    .nav-links a {
      color: var(--text-muted); text-decoration: none;
      font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; transition: color 0.3s;
      letter-spacing: 0.03em; text-transform: uppercase;
    }
    .nav-links a:hover { color: var(--red-500); }
    .nav-cta {
      background: var(--red-600); color: white;
      padding: 0.5rem 1.25rem; border-radius: 8px;
      font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem;
      text-decoration: none; transition: all 0.3s;
      border: none; cursor: pointer;
    }
    .nav-cta:hover { background: var(--red-700); transform: translateY(-1px); }
    .mobile-toggle {
      display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px;
      cursor: pointer; padding: 4px; background: none; border: none;
    }
    .mobile-toggle span {
      width: 24px; height: 2px; background: white;
      border-radius: 2px; transition: 0.3s;
    }
    .mobile-toggle.active span:nth-child(1) { transform: rotate(45deg) translate(5px, 5px); }
    .mobile-toggle.active span:nth-child(2) { opacity: 0; }
    .mobile-toggle.active span:nth-child(3) { transform: rotate(-45deg) translate(5px, -5px); }
    .mobile-menu {
      display: none; position: fixed; inset: 0;
      background: rgba(10,10,10,0.97); z-index: 999;
      padding: 6rem 2rem 2rem; flex-direction: column; gap: 1.5rem;
    }
    .mobile-menu.open { display: flex; }
    .mobile-menu a {
      color: var(--text-secondary); text-decoration: none;
      font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 0.5rem 0;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light); transition: color 0.3s;
    }
    .mobile-menu a:hover { color: var(--red-500); }
    @media (min-width: 768px) {
      .nav-links { display: flex; }
      .mobile-toggle { display: none; }
    }

    /* ===== HERO ===== */
    .hero {
      position: relative; min-height: 100vh;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      text-align: center; padding: 2rem; overflow: hidden;
    }
    .hero-bg {
      position: absolute; inset: 0;
      background-size: cover; background-position: center;
      z-index: 0;
    }
    .hero-bg::after {
      content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0;
      background: 
        radial-gradient(ellipse at 20% 50%, rgba(220,38,38,0.15) 0%, transparent 50%),
        radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 50%, rgba(220,38,38,0.08) 0%, transparent 50%),
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(10,10,10,0.7) 0%, rgba(10,10,10,0.85) 50%, rgba(10,10,10,0.95) 100%);
      z-index: 1;
    }
    .hero-pattern {
      position: absolute; inset: 0;
      background-image: radial-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,0.03) 1px, transparent 1px);
      background-size: 30px 30px; z-index: 2;
    }
    .hero-content { position: relative; z-index: 3; max-width: 56rem; }
    .hero-badge {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem;
      background: rgba(220,38,38,0.1); border: 1px solid rgba(220,38,38,0.2);
      padding: 0.375rem 1rem; border-radius: 100px;
      font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: var(--red-500); margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    }
    .hero-badge-dot {
      width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--red-500); animation: pulse 2s infinite;
    }
    .hero-title {
      font-size: 3rem; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.05;
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem; letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }
    .hero-title .accent {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--red-500), #f97316);
      -webkit-background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; background-clip: text;
    }
    .hero-subtitle {
      font-size: 1.1rem; color: var(--text-muted);
      line-height: 1.7; max-width: 36rem; margin: 0 auto 2.5rem;
    }
    .hero-buttons { display: flex; gap: 1rem; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
    .btn-primary {
      background: var(--red-600); color: white;
      padding: 0.875rem 2rem; border-radius: 10px;
      font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.95rem; text-decoration: none;
      transition: all 0.3s; border: none; cursor: pointer;
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem;
    }
    .btn-primary:hover { background: var(--red-700); transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(220,38,38,0.3); }
    .btn-secondary {
      background: transparent; color: var(--text-secondary);
      padding: 0.875rem 2rem; border-radius: 10px;
      font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.95rem; text-decoration: none;
      transition: all 0.3s; border: 1px solid var(--border); cursor: pointer;
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem;
    }
    .btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--red-500); color: var(--red-400); }
    .hero-stats {
      display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 1.5rem; margin-top: 4rem; padding-top: 2rem;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border-light);
    }
    .hero-stat { text-align: center; }
    .hero-stat-number {
      font-size: 2.5rem; font-weight: 900;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--red-500), #f97316);
      -webkit-background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; background-clip: text;
    }
    .hero-stat-label {
      font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--text-dim);
      text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; margin-top: 0.25rem;
    }
    @media (min-width: 768px) {
      .hero-title { font-size: 4.5rem; }
      .hero-subtitle { font-size: 1.2rem; }
      .hero-stat-number { font-size: 3rem; }
    }

    /* ===== SECTIONS COMMON ===== */
    .section {
      padding: 5rem 1.5rem; max-width: 80rem; margin: 0 auto;
    }
    .section-header { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 3.5rem; }
    .section-label {
      display: inline-block; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600;
      text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.15em;
      color: var(--red-500); margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
    }
    .section-title { font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 900; margin-bottom: 1rem; }
    .section-title .accent {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--red-500), #f97316);
      -webkit-background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; background-clip: text;
    }
    .section-desc { color: var(--text-muted); max-width: 36rem; margin: 0 auto; font-size: 1rem; }
    @media (min-width: 768px) {
      .section-title { font-size: 3rem; }
      .section { padding: 6rem 2rem; }
    }

    /* ===== ABOUT ===== */
    .about-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 2rem; }
    @media (min-width: 768px) { .about-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 3rem; } }
    .about-image {
      position: relative; border-radius: 1rem; overflow: hidden;
      aspect-ratio: 4/3; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(220,38,38,0.1), rgba(23,23,23,0.5));
    }
    .about-image img {
      width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; display: block;
    }
    .about-image-placeholder {
      width: 100%; height: 100%;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      background: radial-gradient(circle at center, rgba(220,38,38,0.15), var(--bg-secondary));
      font-size: 4rem;
    }
    .about-image-overlay {
      position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0; padding: 1.5rem;
      background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(0,0,0,0.8), transparent);
    }
    .about-text h3 { font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 800; margin-bottom: 1rem; }
    .about-text p { color: var(--text-muted); line-height: 1.8; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; }
    .about-features { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 1rem; }
    .about-feature {
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem;
      padding: 0.75rem; background: var(--bg-secondary);
      border-radius: 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
    }
    .about-feature-icon {
      width: 2.5rem; height: 2.5rem; background: rgba(220,38,38,0.15);
      border-radius: 0.5rem; display: flex; align-items: center;
      justify-content: center; font-size: 1.2rem; flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .about-feature-text { font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; }

    /* ===== PROGRAMS ===== */
    .programs-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 1.5rem; }
    @media (min-width: 768px) { .programs-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); } }
    @media (min-width: 1024px) { .programs-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); } }
    .program-card {
      background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
      border-radius: 1rem; padding: 2rem; transition: all 0.3s;
      position: relative; overflow: hidden;
    }
    .program-card::before {
      content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 3px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--red-600), transparent);
      opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.3s;
    }
    .program-card:hover { border-color: rgba(220,38,38,0.3); transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); }
    .program-card:hover::before { opacity: 1; }
    .program-icon {
      width: 3.5rem; height: 3.5rem; background: rgba(220,38,38,0.1);
      border-radius: 0.75rem; display: flex; align-items: center;
      justify-content: center; font-size: 1.5rem; margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
    }
    .program-name { font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; }
    .program-desc { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.9rem; line-height: 1.6; margin-bottom: 1.25rem; }
    .program-meta { display: flex; gap: 1rem; font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--text-dim); }
    .program-meta span { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.375rem; }
    .program-price {
      margin-top: 1rem; padding-top: 1rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-light);
      font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 900; color: var(--red-500);
    }
    .program-price small { font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--text-dim); font-weight: 400; }

    /* ===== COACHES ===== */
    .coaches-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 1.5rem; }
    @media (min-width: 640px) { .coaches-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); } }
    @media (min-width: 1024px) { .coaches-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); } }
    .coach-card {
      background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
      border-radius: 1rem; overflow: hidden; transition: all 0.3s;
    }
    .coach-card:hover { border-color: rgba(220,38,38,0.3); transform: translateY(-4px); }
    .coach-avatar {
      height: 16rem; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(220,38,38,0.1), var(--bg-secondary));
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 4rem;
      overflow: hidden; position: relative;
    }
    .coach-avatar img {
      width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; display: block;
    }
    .coach-info { padding: 1.5rem; }
    .coach-name { font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 0.25rem; }
    .coach-role { font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--red-500); font-weight: 500; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; }
    .coach-bio { font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--text-muted); line-height: 1.6; }
    .coach-badge {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.375rem;
      background: rgba(220,38,38,0.1); padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem;
      border-radius: 100px; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--red-400); margin-top: 0.75rem;
    }

    /* ===== SCHEDULE ===== */
    .schedule-table {
      width: 100%; background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-light); border-radius: 1rem; overflow: hidden;
    }
    .schedule-header {
      display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;
      padding: 1rem 1.5rem; background: var(--bg-secondary);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light);
      font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: var(--text-dim);
    }
    .schedule-row {
      display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;
      padding: 1rem 1.5rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light);
      transition: background 0.3s; font-size: 0.9rem;
    }
    .schedule-row:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
    .schedule-row:hover { background: rgba(220,38,38,0.03); }
    .schedule-day { font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-primary); }
    .schedule-time { color: var(--red-400); font-weight: 500; }
    .schedule-type { color: var(--text-muted); }
    .schedule-level {
      display: inline-flex; padding: 0.2rem 0.6rem;
      border-radius: 100px; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 600;
    }
    .level-beginner { background: rgba(34,197,94,0.1); color: #4ade80; }
    .level-intermediate { background: rgba(234,179,8,0.1); color: #fbbf24; }
    .level-advanced { background: rgba(220,38,38,0.1); color: #f87171; }
    .level-all { background: rgba(99,102,241,0.1); color: #818cf8; }
    @media (max-width: 639px) {
      .schedule-header, .schedule-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; font-size: 0.8rem; }
      .schedule-header span:nth-child(3), .schedule-header span:nth-child(4),
      .schedule-row span:nth-child(3), .schedule-row span:nth-child(4) { display: none; }
    }

    /* ===== GALLERY ===== */
    .gallery-grid {
      display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 1rem;
    }
    @media (min-width: 768px) { .gallery-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); } }
    @media (min-width: 1024px) { .gallery-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); } }
    .gallery-item {
      position: relative; border-radius: 0.75rem; overflow: hidden;
      aspect-ratio: 1; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(220,38,38,0.08), var(--bg-secondary));
      cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.3s;
    }
    .gallery-item:hover { transform: scale(1.03); }
    .gallery-item-inner {
      width: 100%; height: 100%;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      font-size: 2.5rem; overflow: hidden;
    }
    .gallery-item-inner img {
      width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; display: block;
    }
    .gallery-item-overlay {
      position: absolute; inset: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(0,0,0,0.7), transparent 60%);
      opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.3s;
      display: flex; align-items: flex-end; padding: 1rem;
    }
    .gallery-item:hover .gallery-item-overlay { opacity: 1; }
    .gallery-item-label { font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 600; }

    /* ===== VIDEOS ===== */
    .videos-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 1.5rem; }
    @media (min-width: 768px) { .videos-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); } }
    @media (min-width: 1024px) { .videos-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); } }
    .video-card {
      background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
      border-radius: 1rem; overflow: hidden; transition: all 0.3s;
    }
    .video-card:hover { border-color: rgba(220,38,38,0.3); transform: translateY(-4px); }
    .video-card video {
      width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; background: #000;
      display: block; object-fit: cover;
    }
    .video-info { padding: 1.25rem; }
    .video-title { font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 0.375rem; }
    .video-desc { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.85rem; line-height: 1.6; margin-bottom: 1rem; }
    .video-download {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem;
      background: var(--red-600); color: #fff; text-decoration: none;
      padding: 0.5rem 1.1rem; border-radius: 0.5rem;
      font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 600; transition: all 0.3s;
    }
    .video-download:hover { background: var(--red-700); transform: translateY(-1px); }

    /* ===== PRICING ===== */
    .pricing-grid {
      display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 1.5rem;
      max-width: 64rem; margin: 0 auto;
    }
    @media (min-width: 768px) { .pricing-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); } }
    .pricing-card {
      background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
      border-radius: 1rem; padding: 2.5rem 2rem; text-align: center;
      transition: all 0.3s; position: relative;
    }
    .pricing-card.featured {
      border-color: var(--red-600); box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(220,38,38,0.15);
    }
    .pricing-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); }
    .pricing-popular {
      position: absolute; top: -0.75rem; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
      background: var(--red-600); color: white; padding: 0.25rem 1rem;
      border-radius: 100px; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    }
    .pricing-name { font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; }
    .pricing-price { font-size: 3rem; font-weight: 900; margin-bottom: 0.25rem; }
    .pricing-price .currency { font-size: 1.5rem; vertical-align: super; }
    .pricing-price .period { font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--text-dim); font-weight: 400; }
    .pricing-desc { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.85rem; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; }
    .pricing-features { list-style: none; text-align: left; margin-bottom: 2rem; }
    .pricing-features li {
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem;
      padding: 0.5rem 0; font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--text-secondary);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light);
    }
    .pricing-features li:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
    .pricing-check { color: var(--red-500); font-weight: bold; }

    /* ===== TESTIMONIALS ===== */
    .testimonials-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 1.5rem; }
    @media (min-width: 768px) { .testimonials-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); } }
    @media (min-width: 1024px) { .testimonials-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); } }
    .testimonial-card {
      background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
      border-radius: 1rem; padding: 2rem;
    }
    .testimonial-stars { color: #fbbf24; font-size: 0.9rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; }
    .testimonial-text {
      color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.9rem; line-height: 1.7;
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem; font-style: italic;
    }
    .testimonial-author { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; }
    .testimonial-avatar {
      width: 2.5rem; height: 2.5rem; border-radius: 50%;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--red-600), #f97316);
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.8rem;
    }
    .testimonial-name { font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9rem; }
    .testimonial-role { font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--text-dim); }

    /* ===== CONTACT ===== */
    .contact-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 2rem; }
    @media (min-width: 768px) { .contact-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; } }
    .contact-info-card {
      background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
      border-radius: 1rem; padding: 2rem;
    }
    .contact-item {
      display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 1rem; margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    }
    .contact-item:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
    .contact-icon {
      width: 2.75rem; height: 2.75rem; background: rgba(220,38,38,0.1);
      border-radius: 0.75rem; display: flex; align-items: center;
      justify-content: center; font-size: 1.2rem; flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .contact-label { font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--text-dim); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; margin-bottom: 0.25rem; }
    .contact-value { font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.95rem; }
    .contact-form {
      background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
      border-radius: 1rem; padding: 2rem;
    }
    .form-group { margin-bottom: 1.25rem; }
    .form-label {
      display: block; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text-secondary); margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    }
    .form-input, .form-textarea {
      width: 100%; background: var(--bg-secondary);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-light); border-radius: 0.5rem;
      padding: 0.75rem 1rem; color: var(--text-primary);
      font-family: inherit; font-size: 0.9rem; transition: border-color 0.3s;
    }
    .form-input:focus, .form-textarea:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--red-500); }
    .form-textarea { resize: vertical; min-height: 120px; }
    .form-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 1rem; }

    /* ===== FOOTER ===== */
    .footer {
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border-light); padding: 3rem 1.5rem 2rem;
      background: var(--bg-primary);
    }
    .footer-inner { max-width: 80rem; margin: 0 auto; }
    .footer-grid {
      display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 2rem; margin-bottom: 2rem;
    }
    @media (min-width: 768px) { .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr; } }
    .footer-brand p { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.85rem; line-height: 1.7; margin-top: 1rem; max-width: 20rem; }
    .footer-title { font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.85rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; }
    .footer-links { list-style: none; }
    .footer-links li { margin-bottom: 0.5rem; }
    .footer-links a { color: var(--text-muted); text-decoration: none; font-size: 0.85rem; transition: color 0.3s; }

    .footer-bottom {

      flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 1rem; font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--text-dim);

    /* ===== ADMIN PANEL ===== */
    .admin-overlay {
      display: none; position: fixed; inset: 0;

    .admin-overlay.open { display: flex; }
    .admin-panel {

    .admin-close {

    /* Login modal */
    .login-overlay {

    .login-box input {

    /* ===== ANIMATIONS ===== */

    .section-divider {

    .toast {

    .toast.show { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; }

    /* Image modal (lightbox) */
    .lightbox {

    }
  </style>
</head>

<style>
.cms-toolbar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.5rem;margin-bottom:1rem;padding-bottom:1rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-light)}
.cms-note{background:rgba(239,68,68,.08);border:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,.25);border-radius:.6rem;padding:.8rem 1rem;font-size:.78rem;color:var(--text-secondary);line-height:1.65;margin-bottom:1rem}
.cms-note b{color:var(--text-primary)}
.cms-note code{background:#000;padding:.15rem .4rem;border-radius:.3rem;font-size:.72rem;color:var(--red-500)}
.cms-details{border:1px solid var(--border-light);border-radius:.6rem;margin-bottom:.6rem;background:var(--bg-secondary);overflow:hidden}
.cms-details>summary{cursor:pointer;padding:.8rem 1rem;font-weight:700;font-size:.9rem;list-style:none;background:var(--bg-card);transition:background .2s}
.cms-details>summary:hover{background:var(--bg-hover)}
.cms-details>summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.cms-details[open]>summary{border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-light)}
.cms-body-inner{padding:1rem}
.cms-hint{font-size:.75rem;color:var(--text-dim);margin-bottom:.6rem}
.sched-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.1fr 1.4fr 1fr auto;gap:.35rem;margin-bottom:.35rem;align-items:center}
.sched-row input,.sched-row select{background:var(--bg-primary);border:1px solid var(--border-light);color:var(--text-primary);padding:.45rem .5rem;border-radius:.4rem;font-size:.75rem;font-family:inherit;min-width:0;width:100%}
.sched-actions{display:flex;gap:.15rem}
.sched-mini{background:var(--bg-hover);border:none;color:#fff;border-radius:.3rem;padding:.35rem .45rem;cursor:pointer;font-size:.7rem;line-height:1}
.sched-mini:hover{background:var(--red-600)}
@media(max-width:640px){.sched-row{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
</style>

<script>
/* =========================================================================
   FONCTIONS DE BASE DU SITE (menu, animations, connexion, galerie)
   ========================================================================= */
window.showToast = function (msg) {
  var t = document.getElementById('toast');
  if (!t) return;
  t.textContent = 'âœ“ ' + msg;
  t.classList.add('show');
  setTimeout(function () { t.classList.remove('show'); }, 3000);
};

window.closeMobileMenu = function () {
  var tg = document.getElementById('mobileToggle');
  var mm = document.getElementById('mobileMenu');
  if (tg) tg.classList.remove('active');
  if (mm) mm.classList.remove('open');
};

window.openLightbox = function (el) {
  var img = el.querySelector('img');
  if (img) {
    document.getElementById('lightboxImg').src = img.src;
    document.getElementById('lightbox').classList.add('open');
  }
};
window.closeLightbox = function () {
  document.getElementById('lightbox').classList.remove('open');
};

window.closeAdmin = function () {
  document.getElementById('adminOverlay').classList.remove('open');
};
window.closeLogin = function () {
  document.getElementById('loginOverlay').classList.remove('open');
  document.getElementById('loginPassword').value = '';
  document.getElementById('loginError').style.display = 'none';
};

(function () {
  var isLoggedIn = false;

  function getStoredPassword() {
    return localStorage.getItem('clubAdminPwd') || 'admin123';
  }

  var fab = document.getElementById('adminFab');
  if (fab) fab.addEventListener('click', function () {
    if (isLoggedIn) { window.openAdminPanel(); }
    else {
      document.getElementById('loginOverlay').classList.add('open');
      document.getElementById('loginPassword').focus();
    }
  });

  window.attemptLogin = function () {
    var pwd = document.getElementById('loginPassword').value;
    if (pwd === getStoredPassword()) {
      isLoggedIn = true;
      document.getElementById('loginOverlay').classList.remove('open');
      document.getElementById('loginPassword').value = '';
      document.getElementById('loginError').style.display = 'none';
      window.openAdminPanel();
      window.showToast('Connexion rأ©ussie');
    } else {
      document.getElementById('loginError').style.display = 'block';
      document.getElementById('loginPassword').value = '';
    }
  };

  var mt = document.getElementById('mobileToggle');
  if (mt) mt.addEventListener('click', function () {
    this.classList.toggle('active');
    document.getElementById('mobileMenu').classList.toggle('open');
  });

  window.addEventListener('scroll', function () {
    var nb = document.getElementById('navbar');
    if (nb) nb.classList.toggle('scrolled', window.scrollY > 50);
  });

  if (typeof IntersectionObserver !== 'undefined') {
    var observer = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
      entries.forEach(function (e) { if (e.isIntersecting) e.target.classList.add('visible'); });
    }, { threshold: 0.1, rootMargin: '0px 0px -50px 0px' });
    document.querySelectorAll('.fade-in-up').forEach(function (el) { observer.observe(el); });
  } else {
    document.querySelectorAll('.fade-in-up').forEach(function (el) { el.classList.add('visible'); });
  }

  var lo = document.getElementById('loginOverlay');
  if (lo) lo.addEventListener('click', function (e) { if (e.target === this) window.closeLogin(); });
  var ao = document.getElementById('adminOverlay');
  if (ao) ao.addEventListener('click', function (e) { if (e.target === this) window.closeAdmin(); });
})();

/* =========================================================================
   CMS â€” Panneau d'administration complet
   ========================================================================= */
(function () {

  function esc(s) {
    return String(s)
      .replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
      .replace(/"/g, '&quot;').replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
  }
  function unesc(s) {
    return String(s)
      .replace(/&amp;/g, '&').replace(/&lt;/g, '<').replace(/&gt;/g, '>')
      .replace(/&quot;/g, '"').replace(/&#39;/g, "'");
  }
  function innerToEdit(el) {
    var h = el.innerHTML;
    h = h.replace(/<br\s*\/?>/gi, '\n');
    h = h.replace(/<span class="accent">([\s\S]*?)<\/span>/gi, '*$1*');
    h = h.replace(/<[^>]+>/g, '');
    return unesc(h).trim();
  }
  function editToHtml(v) {
    var h = esc(v);
    h = h.replace(/\*([^*\n]+)\*/g, '<span class="accent">$1</span>');
    h = h.replace(/\n/g, '<br>');
    return h;
  }

  var videoFields = [

    { key: 'cvHours',   label: 'Horaires du bureau', type: 'text' }
  ]});

  SCHEMA.push({ title: 'ًں”» Pied de page', fields: [
    { key: 'footerBrand',     label: 'Nom du club', type: 'text' },
    { key: 'footerTagline',   label: 'Slogan', type: 'text' },
    { key: 'footerCopyright', label: 'Mention de copyright', type: 'text' }
  ]});

  var ALLFIELDS = [];
  SCHEMA.forEach(function (s) { s.fields.forEach(function (f) { ALLFIELDS.push(f); }); });

  var IMAGE_KEYS = [
    { key: 'logo',     label: 'Logo du club (rond, en haut أ  gauche)' },
    { key: 'heroBg',   label: 'Image d\'arriأ¨re-plan du Hero' },
    { key: 'aboutImg', label: 'Image de la section أ€ propos' },
    { key: 'coach1',   label: 'Photo entraأ®neur 1' },
    { key: 'coach2',   label: 'Photo entraأ®neur 2' },
    { key: 'coach3',   label: 'Photo entraأ®neur 3' }
  ];
  for (var gi = 0; gi < 8; gi++) {
    IMAGE_KEYS.push({ key: 'gallery' + gi, label: 'Galerie â€” photo ' + (gi + 1) + ' (' + GAL_LABELS[gi] + ')' });
  }

  var DEFAULT_LOGO = '';
  var navLogoEl = document.getElementById('navLogoIcon');
  if (navLogoEl) DEFAULT_LOGO = navLogoEl.innerHTML;

  var pendingImages = {};
  var scheduleData = [];
  var built = false;

  /* ---------------- LECTURE / أ‰CRITURE ---------------- */
  function readCurrent(f) {
    if (f.type === 'videoUrl') {
      var s = document.getElementById('video' + f.videoIndex + 'Source');
      return s ? (s.getAttribute('src') || '') : '';
    }
    var el = document.querySelector('[data-edit="' + f.key + '"]');
    if (!el) return '';
    if (f.type === 'html') return innerToEdit(el);
    if (f.type === 'price') {
      var m = el.textContent.match(/[\d]+(?:[.,]\d+)?/);
      return m ? m[0] : el.textContent.trim();
    }
    if (f.type === 'meta') {
      return Array.prototype.map.call(el.querySelectorAll('span'), function (s) { return s.textContent.trim(); }).join(' | ');
    }
    if (f.type === 'list') {
      return Array.prototype.map.call(el.querySelectorAll('li'), function (li) {
        return li.textContent.replace('âœ“', '').trim();
      }).join('\n');
    }
    return el.textContent.trim();
  }

  function setField(f, val) {
    if (val === undefined || val === null) return;
    if (f.type === 'videoUrl') {
      var n = f.videoIndex;
      var player = document.getElementById('video' + n + 'Player');
      var src = document.getElementById('video' + n + 'Source');
      if (src) src.setAttribute('src', val);
      if (player) { try { player.load(); } catch (e) {} }
      var dl = document.getElementById('video' + n + 'Download');
      if (dl) dl.setAttribute('href', val);
      return;
    }
    var el = document.querySelector('[data-edit="' + f.key + '"]');
    if (!el) return;
    if (f.type === 'html') el.innerHTML = editToHtml(val);
    else if (f.type === 'price') el.innerHTML = esc(val) + 'â‚¬ <small>/mois</small>';
    else if (f.type === 'meta') {
      el.innerHTML = String(val).split('|').map(function (part) {
        return '<span>' + esc(part.trim()) + '</span>';
      }).join('');
    } else if (f.type === 'list') {
      el.innerHTML = String(val).split('\n').map(function (x) { return x.trim(); })
        .filter(function (x) { return x.length; })
        .map(function (x) { return '<li><span class="pricing-check">âœ“</span> ' + esc(x) + '</li>'; }).join('');
    } else el.textContent = val;
  }

  /* ---------------- HORAIRES ---------------- */
  function seedSchedule() {
    var table = document.querySelector('#schedule .schedule-table');
    if (!table) return [];
    return Array.prototype.map.call(table.querySelectorAll('.schedule-row'), function (r) {
      var lvl = r.querySelector('.schedule-level');
      var level = 'all';
      if (lvl) {
        if (lvl.classList.contains('level-beginner')) level = 'beginner';
        else if (lvl.classList.contains('level-intermediate')) level = 'intermediate';
        else if (lvl.classList.contains('level-advanced')) level = 'advanced';
      }
      var d = r.querySelector('.schedule-day'), tm = r.querySelector('.schedule-time'), ty = r.querySelector('.schedule-type');
      return { day: d ? d.textContent.trim() : '', time: tm ? tm.textContent.trim() : '', type: ty ? ty.textContent.trim() : '', level: level };
    });
  }

  function applySchedule(arr) {
    var table = document.querySelector('#schedule .schedule-table');
    if (!table) return;
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(table.querySelectorAll('.schedule-row'), function (r) { r.remove(); });
    (arr || []).forEach(function (row) {
      var lv = LEVELS[row.level] || LEVELS.all;
      var div = document.createElement('div');
      div.className = 'schedule-row';
      div.innerHTML =
        '<span class="schedule-day">' + esc(row.day || '') + '</span>' +
        '<span class="schedule-time">' + esc(row.time || '') + '</span>' +
        '<span class="schedule-type">' + esc(row.type || '') + '</span>' +
        '<span><span class="schedule-level ' + lv.cls + '">' + lv.label + '</span></span>';
      table.appendChild(div);
    });
  }

  function syncSchedule() {
    var rows = document.querySelectorAll('#cmsSchedule .sched-row');
    var out = [];
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(rows, function (r) {
      out.push({
        day: r.querySelector('[data-f="day"]').value,
        time: r.querySelector('[data-f="time"]').value,
        type: r.querySelector('[data-f="type"]').value,
        level: r.querySelector('[data-f="level"]').value
      });
    });
    scheduleData = out;
  }

  function renderScheduleEditor() {
    var box = document.getElementById('cmsSchedule');
    if (!box) return;
    var html = '<div class="cms-hint">Ajoutez, modifiez, rأ©organisez ou supprimez les crأ©neaux d\'entraأ®nement.</div>';
    scheduleData.forEach(function (row, i) {
      html += '<div class="sched-row">' +
        '<input type="text" data-i="' + i + '" data-f="day" list="daysList" value="' + esc(row.day || '') + '" placeholder="Jour">' +
        '<input type="text" data-i="' + i + '" data-f="time" value="' + esc(row.time || '') + '" placeholder="18h00 - 20h00">' +
        '<input type="text" data-i="' + i + '" data-f="type" value="' + esc(row.type || '') + '" placeholder="Type de sأ©ance">' +
        '<select data-i="' + i + '" data-f="level">' +
          Object.keys(LEVELS).map(function (k) {
            return '<option value="' + k + '"' + (row.level === k ? ' selected' : '') + '>' + LEVELS[k].label + '</option>';
          }).join('') +
        '</select>' +
        '<span class="sched-actions">' +
          '<button class="sched-mini" onclick="schedMove(' + i + ',-1)" title="Monter">â–²</button>' +
          '<button class="sched-mini" onclick="schedMove(' + i + ',1)" title="Descendre">â–¼</button>' +
          '<button class="sched-mini" onclick="schedDelete(' + i + ')" title="Supprimer">ًں—‘ï¸ڈ</button>' +
        '</span>' +
      '</div>';
    });
    html += '<button class="admin-btn admin-btn-secondary" style="margin-top:.5rem" onclick="schedAdd()">â‍• Ajouter un crأ©neau</button>';
    html += '<datalist id="daysList">' + DAYS.map(function (d) { return '<option value="' + d + '">'; }).join('') + '</datalist>';
    box.innerHTML = html;
  }

  window.schedAdd = function () {
    syncSchedule();
    scheduleData.push({ day: 'Lundi', time: '', type: '', level: 'all' });
    renderScheduleEditor();
  };
  window.schedDelete = function (i) {
    syncSchedule();
    scheduleData.splice(i, 1);
    renderScheduleEditor();
  };
  window.schedMove = function (i, dir) {
    syncSchedule();
    var j = i + dir;
    if (j < 0 || j >= scheduleData.length) return;
    var tmp = scheduleData[i];
    scheduleData[i] = scheduleData[j];
    scheduleData[j] = tmp;
    renderScheduleEditor();
  };

  /* ---------------- CONSTRUCTION DU PANNEAU ---------------- */
  function buildCms() {
    if (built) return;
    var body = document.getElementById('cmsBody');
    var html = '';
    SCHEMA.forEach(function (sec, si) {
      html += '<details class="cms-details"' + (si === 0 ? ' open' : '') + '><summary>' + sec.title + '</summary><div class="cms-body-inner">';
      sec.fields.forEach(function (f) {
        html += '<div class="admin-field"><label>' + f.label + '</label>';
        if (f.type === 'textarea' || f.type === 'html' || f.type === 'list') {
          html += '<textarea rows="' + (f.type === 'html' ? 2 : 3) + '" id="cms_' + f.key + '"></textarea>';
        } else {
          html += '<input type="text" id="cms_' + f.key + '">';
        }
        html += '</div>';
      });
      if (sec.special === 'schedule') html += '<div id="cmsSchedule"></div>';
      html += '</div></details>';
    });
    html += '<details class="cms-details"><summary>ًں“· Images &amp; logo</summary><div class="cms-body-inner">';
    IMAGE_KEYS.forEach(function (im) {
      html += '<div class="admin-image-field"><label>' + im.label + '</label>' +
        '<img class="admin-image-preview" id="prev_' + im.key + '">' +
        '<div class="admin-image-upload">' +
          '<input type="file" accept="image/*" data-imgkey="' + im.key + '" onchange="cmsImgPick(this)">' +
          '<label class="admin-image-btn">ًں“پ Choisir</label>' +
          '<button class="admin-image-remove" onclick="cmsImgRemove(\'' + im.key + '\')">ًں—‘ï¸ڈ</button>' +
          '<span class="admin-image-name" id="name_' + im.key + '"></span>' +
        '</div></div>';
    });
    html += '</div></details>';
    body.innerHTML = html;
    built = true;
  }

  function cmsLoadValues() {
    var data = {};
    try { data = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('clubData') || '{}'); } catch (e) { data = {}; }
    ALLFIELDS.forEach(function (f) {
      var el = document.getElementById('cms_' + f.key);
      if (!el) return;
      var v = (data[f.key] !== undefined && data[f.key] !== '') ? data[f.key] : readCurrent(f);
      el.value = v;
    });
    scheduleData = (data.schedule && data.schedule.length) ? data.schedule : seedSchedule();
    renderScheduleEditor();
    IMAGE_KEYS.forEach(function (im) {
      var src = localStorage.getItem('clubImg_' + im.key);
      var prev = document.getElementById('prev_' + im.key);
      if (prev) {
        if (src && src !== 'REMOVE') { prev.src = src; prev.classList.add('visible'); }
        else { prev.src = ''; prev.classList.remove('visible'); }
      }
    });
    pendingImages = {};
  }

  /* ---------------- IMAGES ---------------- */
  function cmsImgPick(input) {
    var file = input.files[0];
    if (!file) return;
    var key = input.getAttribute('data-imgkey');
    var reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = function (e) {
      var img = new Image();
      img.onload = function () {
        var canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
        var maxW = 1400, maxH = 1100;
        var w = img.width, h = img.height;
        if (w > maxW) { h = h * maxW / w; w = maxW; }
        if (h > maxH) { w = w * maxH / h; h = maxH; }
        canvas.width = w; canvas.height = h;
        canvas.getContext('2d').drawImage(img, 0, 0, w, h);
        var dataUrl = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.8);
        pendingImages[key] = dataUrl;
        var prev = document.getElementById('prev_' + key);
        if (prev) { prev.src = dataUrl; prev.classList.add('visible'); }
        var nm = document.getElementById('name_' + key);
        if (nm) nm.textContent = file.name;
      };
      img.src = e.target.result;
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  }
  window.cmsImgPick = cmsImgPick;

  function cmsImgRemove(key) {
    pendingImages[key] = 'REMOVE';
    var prev = document.getElementById('prev_' + key);
    if (prev) { prev.src = ''; prev.classList.remove('visible'); }
    var nm = document.getElementById('name_' + key);
    if (nm) nm.textContent = '';
  }
  window.cmsImgRemove = cmsImgRemove;

  /* ---------------- APPLIQUER LES IMAGES ---------------- */
  function applyImage(key, src) {
    if (key === 'logo') {
      var el = document.getElementById('navLogoIcon');
      if (el) el.innerHTML = src ? '<img src="' + src + '" alt="Logo">' : DEFAULT_LOGO;
    } else if (key === 'heroBg') {
      var hb = document.getElementById('heroBg');
      if (hb) hb.style.backgroundImage = src ? 'url(' + src + ')' : '';
    } else if (key === 'aboutImg') {
      var img = document.getElementById('aboutImage');
      var ph = document.getElementById('aboutPlaceholder');
      if (src) { img.src = src; img.style.display = 'block'; if (ph) ph.style.display = 'none'; }
      else { img.style.display = 'none'; if (ph) ph.style.display = 'flex'; }
    } else if (key.indexOf('coach') === 0) {
      var n = key.replace('coach', '');
      var ci = document.getElementById('coach' + n + 'Img');
      var ce = document.getElementById('coach' + n + 'Emoji');
      if (src) { ci.src = src; ci.style.display = 'block'; if (ce) ce.style.display = 'none'; }
      else { ci.style.display = 'none'; if (ce) ce.style.display = 'block'; }
    } else if (key.indexOf('gallery') === 0) {
      var gi2 = key.replace('gallery', '');
      var inner = document.getElementById('gallery' + gi2 + 'Inner');
      if (inner) inner.innerHTML = src
        ? '<img src="' + src + '" alt="' + (GAL_LABELS[gi2] || '') + '">'
        : ['ًں¤¼','ًںڈ†','ًں’ھ','ًں¥‡','ًں¤‌','ًںڈ‹ï¸ڈ','ًں§ک','ًںژ‰'][gi2];
    }
  }

  /* ---------------- ENREGISTRER ---------------- */
  window.saveAllChanges = function () {
    var data = {};
    ALLFIELDS.forEach(function (f) {
      var el = document.getElementById('cms_' + f.key);
      if (el) data[f.key] = el.value;
    });
    syncSchedule();
    data.schedule = scheduleData;
    try {
      localStorage.setItem('clubData', JSON.stringify(data));
    } catch (e) {
      window.showToast('Mأ©moire pleine â€” rأ©duisez le nombre d\'images');
      return;
    }
    Object.keys(pendingImages).forEach(function (k) {
      if (pendingImages[k] === 'REMOVE') localStorage.removeItem('clubImg_' + k);
      else {
        try { localStorage.setItem('clubImg_' + k, pendingImages[k]); }
        catch (e) { window.showToast('Image trop lourde : ' + k); }
      }
    });
    pendingImages = {};
    ALLFIELDS.forEach(function (f) { setField(f, data[f.key]); });
    applySchedule(data.schedule);
    window.changePassword(true);
    window.showToast('Modifications enregistrأ©es');
  };

  window.changePassword = function (silent) {
    var a = document.getElementById('adminNewPassword');
    var b = document.getElementById('adminConfirmPassword');
    if (!a || !b) return;
    if (!a.value && !b.value) return;
    if (a.value !== b.value) { window.showToast('Les mots de passe ne correspondent pas'); return; }
    if (a.value.length < 4) { window.showToast('Mot de passe trop court (4 min.)'); return; }
    localStorage.setItem('clubAdminPwd', a.value);
    a.value = ''; b.value = '';
    if (!silent) window.showToast('Mot de passe modifiأ©');
  };

  window.resetAllContent = function () {
    if (!confirm('Rأ©initialiser tout le contenu (textes, horaires, images) et revenir أ  l\'original ?')) return;
    localStorage.removeItem('clubData');
    IMAGE_KEYS.forEach(function (im) { localStorage.removeItem('clubImg_' + im.key); });
    location.reload();
  };

  window.exportJSON = function () {
    var data = {};
    try { data = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('clubData') || '{}'); } catch (e) {}
    syncSchedule();
    data.schedule = scheduleData;
    IMAGE_KEYS.forEach(function (im) {
      var s = localStorage.getItem('clubImg_' + im.key);
      if (s && s !== 'REMOVE') data['_img_' + im.key] = s;
    });
    var blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(data, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' });
    var a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    a.download = 'contenu-club-lutte.json';
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);
    window.showToast('Sauvegarde exportأ©e');
  };

  window.importJSON = function (input) {
    var file = input.files[0];
    if (!file) return;
    var reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = function (e) {
      try {
        var data = JSON.parse(e.target.result);
        Object.keys(data).forEach(function (k) {
          if (k.indexOf('_img_') === 0) localStorage.setItem('clubImg_' + k.slice(5), data[k]);
        });
        var clean = {};
        Object.keys(data).forEach(function (k) { if (k.indexOf('_img_') !== 0) clean[k] = data[k]; });
        try { localStorage.setItem('clubData', JSON.stringify(clean)); } catch (err) {}
        window.showToast('Contenu importأ©');
        setTimeout(function () { location.reload(); }, 600);
      } catch (err) {
        window.showToast('Fichier JSON invalide');
      }
      input.value = '';
    };
    reader.readAsText(file);
  };

  window.downloadHTML = function () {
    window.saveAllChanges();
    var clone = document.documentElement.cloneNode(true);
    ['#adminOverlay', '#loginOverlay', '#mobileMenu'].forEach(function (sel) {
      var el = clone.querySelector(sel);
      if (el) el.classList.remove('open');
    });
    var doc = '<!DOCTYPE html>\n' + clone.outerHTML;
    var blob = new Blob([doc], { type: 'text/html;charset=utf-8' });
    var a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    a.download = 'wrestling-club.html';
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);
    window.showToast('Fichier HTML tأ©lأ©chargأ©');
  };

  /* ---------------- OUVRIR LE PANNEAU ---------------- */
  window.openAdminPanel = function () {
    buildCms();
    cmsLoadValues();
    document.getElementById('adminOverlay').classList.add('open');
  };

  /* ---------------- CHARGER AU Dأ‰MARRAGE ---------------- */
  function loadAllContent() {
    var data = {};
    try { data = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('clubData') || '{}'); } catch (e) { return; }
    ALLFIELDS.forEach(function (f) {
      if (data[f.key] !== undefined && data[f.key] !== '') setField(f, data[f.key]);
    });
    if (data.schedule && data.schedule.length) applySchedule(data.schedule);
    IMAGE_KEYS.forEach(function (im) {
      var src = localStorage.getItem('clubImg_' + im.key);
      if (src && src !== 'REMOVE') applyImage(im.key, src);
      else if (src === 'REMOVE') applyImage(im.key, '');
    });
    scheduleData = (data.schedule && data.schedule.length) ? data.schedule : seedSchedule();
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', loadAllContent);
  else loadAllContent();
})();
</script>
    </div>
  </div>
<script type="module" src="https://static.cloudflareinsights.com/beacon.min.js/v31edd6df95cf4e85bb4c19e7a9bdbcba1788362987495" integrity="sha512-iIg7k2xntmwu6/uSb5tpc/hySgZc4eoL31yB29W6tJFo2akwjPWcEqnCEdJvGexCL0KEQwVYv5BlowfhVz26hg==" data-cf-beacon="{&quot;version&quot;:&quot;2024.11.0&quot;,&quot;token&quot;:&quot;4edd5f8ec12a48cfa682ab8261b80a79&quot;,&quot;spa&quot;:2}" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>
